text: This report provides an update to the Board of Health on the Toronto Public Health (TPH) Capital Budget Variance for the twelve months ended on December 31, 2018. As of December 31, 2018, TPH spent $3.358 million, representing 73.4 percent of the 2018 Approved Capital Budget of $4.575 million.
The Board of Health received the report (May 31, 2019) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
